INSERT INTO finance_management (finance_id, management_index_id, inserted_at, deleted) SELECT f.finance_id, m.management_index_id, now(), false FROM finance f JOIN management_index m ON m.merge_key = #{mergeKey} WHERE f.merge_key = #{financeMergeKey} ON CONFLICT (finance_id, management_index_id) DO UPDATE SET deleted = false, updated_at = now() WHERE finance_management.deleted IS DISTINCT FROM false
UPDATE finance_management fm SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() WHERE fm.deleted = false AND fm.finance_id = ( SELECT f.finance_id FROM finance f WHERE f.merge_key = #{financeMergeKey} )
